about: Server one-frame event (registry does not mark it one-frame) emitted when a moving entity enters the attack range of an entity that can react (attacks of opportunity). Built from esv::move::ReactionSystem::InAttackRangeChangedEventData in ReactionSystem::TriggerInAttackRangeChangedEvents; consumed by esv::interrupt::EventSystem. Seen.py context: fights, shove/throw, spell steps, the first fight - whenever something moved near enemies.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll+0x422760 TriggerInAttackRangeChangedEvents builds InAttackRangeChangedEventData (stride 0x20): +0 = entity of the candidate reactor (list element +0, stride 0x28) that can see the mover. Live: entity handles. Game name: member 0 (m_Source) of savegame model ls::model::game::move::v0::EnterAttackRangeEventOneFrameComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x4FF1FA0) and the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x259F9C0: model EntityId +0 <-> component +0.

+8 = the moving entity (EntityView param +0x38). Live: entity handles. Game name: member 1 (m_Target) of savegame model ls::model::game::move::v0::EnterAttackRangeEventOneFrameComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x4FF1FA0) and the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x259F9C0: model EntityId +8 <-> component +8.

+0x10..+0x1C = three floats from candidate +0x10/+0x18. Live: world coordinates (47.3, 2.1, 404.9). Game name: member 2 (m_EnterPosition) of savegame model ls::model::game::move::v0::EnterAttackRangeEventOneFrameComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x4FF1FA0) and the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x259F9C0: model vec3 +0x10 <-> component +0x10.
Low byte from candidate +0x20 (upper three bytes are left over from the stack). Live: 0x00 or 0xFF in every byte.
Uninitialised bytes (copied from a stack word).

survey.names_pass: All three model members matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x259F9C0 and the macOS Save. field_1C is not saved (the loader writes 16 bytes at +0x10, leaving +0x1C as junk) - not in the model.
open_questions: Assumes the component stores InAttackRangeChangedEventData unchanged (same 32 bytes); the hand-over into the component was not read.
Whether Position is the observer's or the mover's position; meaning of the byte at +0x1C.
